band|page.method: Percentile band from the page alone: a text model trained on 2,974 featured launches (2026-01-01 to 2026-10-24) scores this page above 35% of them. The ranges are where launches in that tenth actually finished (10th to 90th percentile).
band|page.honesty: Pre-launch rank prediction is weak, and weaker still from a page alone. Tested month-forward on 222 days using Product Hunt launch descriptions, the description-only model put 29% / 40% / 60% of the real top 3 / 5 / 10 in its own top 3 / 5 / 10; a read of your web page is a weaker input than that. Our previous 00:05 PT launch model, which also knew the hunter, makers and team history, scored 52 / 60 / 74 live over 11 days. Who hunts it and who shows up on the day decide most of the result.
band|page.input_note: Scored from your web page alone with a model trained on product web pages: on 856 held-out launches its rank correlation was 0.28 (2026-11-12). A pasted launch description scored somewhat higher on the same launches (0.35 vs 0.28). The top-3 table below was measured on Product Hunt descriptions.

RX|page: This looks really promising for AI development. Having a curated marketplace for diverse datasets like speech and video is a huge time-saver. How often are new datasets added?

As a founder, finding high-quality, licensed data is always a bottleneck. The variety here is impressive, especially the clinical data. My main concern is the lack of transparent pricing – custom quotes can slow down evaluation significantly.

A centralized marketplace for AI datasets is definitely needed. The detailed metadata is a big plus. I'm curious about the 'Perit-built' vs. 'Licensed catalog' distinction; could you elaborate on the quality control for each?

Finally, a place for unique datasets beyond the usual open-source ones! The volume of audio and video data is massive. Are there any APIs for programmatic access to dataset metadata or for initiating custom collection requests?

Another data marketplace. The dataset variety is decent, but 'Lead (metadata only)' or 'Collecting' for availability is a bit of a letdown for immediate needs. Pricing transparency is key for adoption in this space.
Interesting to see a dedicated marketplace for AI datasets. While not directly related to my product, I can see the value for teams building AI. Good luck with the launch!
